Scene:
古代的时候，一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。他很喜欢他的城市，但是城市有才两个学校，都很小。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 古代的时候：在古代
- 但是城市有才两个学校：这个城市，只有

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Reference): 他很喜欢他的城市：他很喜欢自己的城市，when the subject and the possessor are the same person, 自己的 makes that relationship clear.
Run 2: Coherence (Reference): 他的城市：自己住的城市，when the possessor is the same person as the subject, 自己 makes that relationship clear; adding 住的 also specifies which city is meant.
Run 3: Coherence (Reference): 他的城市：自己的城市，when the possessor is the same person as the subject, use 自己的 to make that relationship clear.

output.reason: All runs address the same reflexive possessive issue in “他的城市,” and each replacement correctly clarifies that it is the city where Mencius lives.
